case_title: BLACKBURN MICHAEL EUGENE VS ROYAL MOTORS/ SALES & SERVICE DEPT.

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,500.00 FILED BY BLACKBURN MICHAEL EUGENE AS TO DEFENDANT ROYAL MOTORS/ SALES & SERVICE DEPT. ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR SEP-10-1993 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 08

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF BLACKBURN MICHAEL EUGENE RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT ROYAL MOTORS/ SALES & SERVICE DEPT. $350.00 PRINCIPAL, $15.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $365.00 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
